guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect a Wallet
guide.description: Open the AMA Hub quests page and connect an EVM wallet such as MetaMask, Rabby, or Trust. This is the address your PRIME Points are paid to.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create Your Amadeus Wallet
guide.description: Install the Amadeus Wallet browser extension and set it up. This wallet holds $AMA and runs your sealed agents, and creating it is one of the larger one-off point rewards in the season.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Link Both Wallets
guide.description: Sign once from each wallet to connect them. The link tells the season that your chain address and Amadeus account belong to the same person, and quests stay locked until both are added.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Daily Check-In
guide.description: Return each day and claim the check-in on the quests page. Daily points reset and do not carry over, so steady visits matter more than any single session.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Build and Deploy an Agent
guide.description: Create an agent on AMA Hub and put it to work. These build quests are read directly from the chain, so nothing needs to be submitted. To earn across more of them: Add a skill to your agent so it can act Run an agent trade or swap on the network Claim a username for your account
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Finish the Social Quests
guide.description: Complete the social tasks, which the campaign verifies within a few minutes: Follow Amadeus on X Join the Amadeus Discord Engage with the pinned launch post Record a short video explainer for the largest social reward
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite Referrals
guide.description: Share your referral link from the quests page. You earn 20% of the PRIME Points your invitees collect, which compounds as they stay active.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
适合。操作难度较低，建议按教程逐步完成。
